turnaround_reason: SPSC, the leading cloud EDI/retail supply-chain network, fell from $124 to a $49 low as SaaS multiples compressed and revenue growth cooled to high-single-digits. It remains a high-quality, sticky, net-cash compounder — the 'turnaround' here is multiple re-rating off an oversold base rather than a broken business being fixed.
bullish_points: Consistent operational execution: EPS beats of ~13% for four straight quarters; 69% gross margin, 12.8% operating margin, +$152M FCF
Pristine balance sheet: $154M cash vs $6.6M debt — effectively net cash, low-risk compounder
Forward P/E ~12.9 vs trailing ~27.8 marks a sharp earnings-power inflection; recovering back above its 200-day MA
Heavy insider net buying over 6 months (net +396k shares) and active buybacks
Portfolio pruning (divested a non-core unit) to refocus on multi-retailer 1P suppliers — cleaner growth algorithm
bearish_points: Binary risk on entry: Q2 prints TONIGHT (after close July 30) and the stock is already +14% over 5 days into the number
Still not cheap on trailing earnings (~28x) for a ~6% grower — the re-rate relies on the forward estimates being right
Q2 will carry an estimated ~$20M loss on the divestiture, which could muddy the headline
Options are illiquid (call OI 61 / put OI 10) with unreliable IV data — spot only
Growth is decelerating structurally; if retail IT budgets tighten, network adds slow
catalyst: Q2 2026 earnings tonight (post-close, July 30) — guidance for H2 and any raise to the FY $796-802M revenue / $2.66-2.69 EPS outlook is the swing factor
suggested_trade: Wait for tonight's print — do NOT buy the +14% run-up into a binary event. If it sells off on an in-line quarter, that's a cleaner spot entry on a high-quality name.
key_risk: Buying immediately ahead of earnings after a big run: an in-line-but-not-a-beat quarter triggers a sharp mean-reversion pullback
would_skip_if: Entering before the tonight print; revisit after the reaction rather than gambling on the number
